intent.text: Adds an optional voucher to account payments: `VouchersController.cs:20-27` takes it, `VoucherService.cs:27-31` stores it, and account totals include it.

how.title: The API records a voucher
how.text: `POST /voucher` validates the amount in `VouchersController.cs:23` and hands it to `VoucherService.cs`.

how.title: One Voucher row in the same unit of work
how.text: The voucher row and the payment are saved in the same unit of work, so a failed payment never leaves a voucher behind.

how.title: Totals include vouchers
how.text: `AccountService.cs:44-58` adds vouchers to the account total; the client page shows them.

invariants.text: A voucher is never negative and never more than the account total.

notChanged.text: Refunds and inventory reports are untouched.

notCovered.text: Generated client models and the migration designer.

verify.text: Pay an account with a voucher of 0, a negative voucher and a voucher above the total.
